verdict.rationale: Terraform's CLI natively supports headless plan generation with machine-readable JSON output (terraform plan -out, terraform show -json) and auto-approve apply, which an agent can orchestrate to author changes, run a plan non-interactively, and present the diff for human approval before applying; this was hands-on verified in probes. missing for 10: no first-party end-to-end agent-orchestration example (e.g., a documented agent workflow chaining plan-json diff presentation to a human approval gate) or independent third-party report of an agent doing this specific plan-review-apply loop.
